idea-plugin.name: OneClick
idea-plugin.description:
Smart code generator plugin for IntelliJ IDEA. One shortcut key generates JavaBean methods and enum parse methods.
Key Features: • JSON format toString method - Compliant with Alibaba code standards, no JSON utility classes needed, avoiding performance issues and exception risks • Auto-generate JSON format toString, log printing directly gets JSON format for easy debugging
Core Functions: • Smart one-click generation - Shortcut: Shift+Alt+D (Windows/Linux) / Cmd+Shift+D (Mac) • JavaBean method generation - Auto-generate getter/setter/toString (JSON format) • Enum parse method - Auto-generate parse method based on code field • Variable naming style conversion - Cycle through 4 naming styles • DTO/VO/BO class generation - Select class name to auto-generate data transfer object classes
Usage Scenarios: • Press shortcut in Java class to generate JavaBean methods (including JSON format toString) • Press shortcut in enum class to generate parse method • Select variable name and press shortcut to cycle through naming styles • Select class name and press shortcut to generate DTO/VO/BO classes
Quick Start: Press Shift+Alt+D (Windows/Linux) / Cmd+Shift+D (Mac) in Java class or enum class

action.description: 智能一键生成：JavaBean方法或枚举类parse方法
